svg.title: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: objects in memory

g.text: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: objects in memory
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: One live run of an eval of six conversations, going. In the API the desk holds the run and a cancel signal joined with the host's own, and the work plays under it.
In the browser's circuit the page holds its timer and the run it last read.
